scope: 30-item short paired raw acquisition;24 actual1-repeat class0 and6 actual8-repeat controls; unknown repeat count inferred from public tail
selection: First eligible pair by initial timestamp, both initial/final within TX start+1.5s to end-.3s, never by prediction
gain_rule: First freeze AGC; if ADC peak>=.9*2048, step down6dB for hard saturation or ceil20log10(peak/(.8*2048)) otherwise; at most3 bounded recaptures
